description: This file contains a Perl script implementing GHASH functions optimized for ARMv8 Crypto Extensions, supporting both AArch32 and AArch64 modes. It includes functions for initializing precomputed tables, performing multiplication, and hashing, with specific optimizations for 64-bit and 32-bit architectures.

methods.name: gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the H table with precomputed powers of the hash key for GHASH.

methods.name: gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs GHASH multiplication on the current hash value using the precomputed table.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Processes input data to update the hash value using GHASH algorithm.

methods.name: gcm_ghash_v8_4x
methods.description: Processes four blocks in parallel for GHASH, optimized for 64-bit ARM architecture.
